description: This script generates transitive dependencies for custom builds in PyTorch, processing YAML files of operator dependencies and root operators to produce an allowlist of dependencies.

methods.name: canonical_name
methods.description: Converts operator name to a canonical form by removing overload suffix.

methods.name: load_op_dep_graph
methods.description: Loads operator dependency graph from a YAML file into a dictionary.

methods.name: load_root_ops
methods.description: Loads list of root operators from a YAML file.

methods.name: gen_transitive_closure
methods.description: Generates transitive closure of dependencies starting from root operators.

methods.name: gen_transitive_closure_str
methods.description: Returns transitive closure as a space-separated string.
